tarotcards.config.advancement_lock.desc: If enabled, players must complete specific advancements to unlock the power of tarot cards
tarotcards.config.cards.death_damagebonu: Percentage of damage increase to living (0.5 = +50%)
tarotcards.config.cards.judgement_damage: Percentage chance of dealing double damage (0.5 = 50%)
tarotcards.config.cards.justice_damagemu: Percentage of damage returned to the attacker (1.0 = 100%)
tarotcards.config.cards.temperance_reduc: Multiplier for hunger gained (0.5 = -50%, 0 = no change)
tarotcards.config.cards.the_empress_bree: Enables automatic breeding for nearby animals
tarotcards.config.cards.the_empress_rang: The range in which nearby adult animals automatically enter breeding and baby animals grow faster
tarotcards.config.cards.the_hanged_man_x: Max amount of experience that can be obtained from an instance of damage
How much of the damage is converted to experience
tarotcards.config.cards.the_hermit_allyr: How far away the player must be from allies to activate
tarotcards.config.cards.the_hermit_armor: How much armor is added when away from allies
tarotcards.config.cards.the_highpriestes: Stops upgrading enchantment books when they are at max level
Allows enchantment books to be upgraded beyond their natural max level by this many additional levels (only works if capenchants is true)
If enabled, the card will automatically search for the first enchantment that hasn't reached its level cap. If disabled, it only attempts to upgrade the very first enchantment in the list
Converts level cost to fixed XP points. Ex: if an upgrade costs 5 levels, it only deducts the XP needed for Lv.0-5, instead of dropping a Lv.100 player down to 95
How much each level of enchantment costs to upgrade (cost = enchantment_level * this_config)
tarotcards.config.cards.the_lovers_range: How close allies need to be to apply regeneration
How close non-allies need to be to apply slowness
tarotcards.config.cards.wheel_of_fortune: How much luck (not fortune) is added to the player
tarotcards.config.effect_based_targeting: When enabled, this restricts positive effects to players and allies, and negative effects to enemies
tarotcards.config.level_lock.desc: If enabled, players must reach a specific experience level to activate the effects of a tarot card
tarotcards.config.loot.default_loot_chan: Chance a tarot card appears in default loot (0.75 = 75%)(1.0 = there will always be a single tarot card in chests)
tarotcards.config.loot.do_loot_generatio: If Tarot Cards should be added to the default loot tables specified in data
tarotcards.config.loot.target_loots.desc: Tarot cards will generate in the loot tables from this list (fabric only)
Define the minimum experience level required for each tarot card
tarotcards.config.per_player_deck_size.d: Allows individual player deck sizes to override the global setting. In this mode, tarot_deck_size is used as the default value.
Requires the card to be in your curio slot, or in the tarot deck (also in the curio slot) to function
Maps each tarot card to a specific advancement path. If empty or invalid, no advancement will be required
tarotcards.config.tarot_deck_applies_eff: If cards in the tarot deck apply their effects to the player holding it
tarotcards.config.tarot_deck_size.desc: The maximum capacity of the tarot deck, determines the number of active slots in the deck gui (0-22).
tarotcards.config.tick_rate.desc: How many ticks it takes to check if a player has a tarot or not, more = more performace but longer time to activate/deactivate effects
